name: Stated cost methodology and trends: behind-the-meter versus grid, modular versus conventional plant
description: Method statements and trends quoted from pages actually read. These are source-authored interpretations, preserved as such rather than re-derived.

capex.metric: reported OEM order-price index, heavy-duty and aero turbines, index FY2025=100
capex.basis: HTR Table 5: 2024 about 91, 2025 100, 2026 about 150; one large OEM reports 2026 orders priced about 50% above 2025. Producer price index for shipments lags at 103.4.

capex.metric: power and distribution transformer price indices increase since January 2020
capex.basis: HTR quoting two federal transformer price indices

capex.metric: TCO advantage of engine over combined cycle, US simulated hyperscale data centre
capex.basis: MTU Solutions simulation using real hyperscale load profiles and high-speed S4000L64FNER gas engines; primarily driven by favourable US gas prices and CAPEX

capex.metric: TCO saving from trigeneration versus power only, engine-based US case
capex.basis: MTU Solutions simulation scenario 3; turbine trigeneration scenario 4 saves 13%

capex.metric: TCO increase replacing CCGT with OCGT, European simulated case
capex.basis: MTU Solutions: mainly attributable to higher fuel costs; European gas prices stated as five times 2024 US levels

capex.metric: range of BTM generation price premium paid for speed
capex.basis: HTR states buyers pay a premium of about $15-40/MWh over grid supply for speed and certainty

capex.metric: power share of data-centre total cost of ownership
capex.basis: RaboResearch: power is 10-15% of a data centre's TCO yet is the binding constraint on revenue generation

capex.metric: CCGT capital cost multiple versus early 2020s projects
capex.basis: IEEFA: newest CCGT proposals roughly triple the cost of projects built in the early 2020s; orders likely not fulfilled until 2030 or later

capex.metric: turbine reservation fee paid by KU/LG&E to secure a 2030 delivery slot
capex.basis: GridLab citing Kentucky PSC Case 2025-00045; reservation fee to GE Vernova

capex.metric: CapEx reduction claimed for verified surplus equipment versus OEM list pricing
capex.basis: EPC vendor USP&E claim; lead time reduced by 12-24 months; vendor claim, not a transaction

sources.note: Method statements and trends quoted from pages actually read. These are source-a
